verdict.rationale: Deepgram's docs say requests join the Model Improvement Program and are retained by default. Users can opt out per request with mip_opt_out=true, and opted-out requests are not retained. That gives a real but coarse retention control, with retention as the default and opt-out required on each request. missing for 10: an explicit data deletion mechanism or API, configurable retention periods, account-level retention settings, documentation specific to Voice Agent retention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
